docs.title: django-ingredients
docs.text:
Food ingredient catalog for Django: types, categories, nutrition fields, allergen presence, Filer images, and an idempotent seed loader.

Default language is English. Italian catalog labels are the historical source; English name_en values are filled from known mappings where available, otherwise a Title-Case of the ASCII slug (provisional — refine over time).

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install django-ingredients

Until the sibling package is on PyPI, CI/install may use the GitHub source for django-allergens (see pyproject.toml).

INSTALLED_APPS = [
    "modeltranslation",
    # ...
    "easy_thumbnails",
    "filer",
    "mptt",
    "polymorphic",
    "allergens",
    "ingredients",
]

python manage.py migrate
python manage.py load_ingredient_catalog

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from ingredients.models import Ingredient

item = Ingredient.objects.get(slug="alchermes")
print(item.name_en, item.name_it)

URL path prefixes translate via gettext:

  • English: /en/ingredients/...
  • Italian: /it/ingredienti/...
